summary: Publish web embed releases from verified exact tags without redundant target resolution

compatibility.detail: No runtime wire, client or harness contract change.

downtime.detail: No daemon change or restart required.

manual.detail: Embed publication retains exact-source Git tag verification and omits redundant release target_commitish resolution, which returns HTTP 504 under the workflow token. Optional metadata-only HTTP diagnostics omit credentials and bodies.

recovery.detail: Existing idempotent draft recovery and published-asset immutability remain unchanged.
